boilerplate_profiles.label: Android Development
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route Android/Kotlin/Gradle work through platform-aware mobile rules.
rules: Respect Android module and Gradle structure.
Do not invent Android Studio, AGP or Kotlin versions.
Treat manifest, permission and signing changes as high-risk.

boilerplate_profiles.label: iOS Development
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Route iOS/Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit work through platform-aware mobile rules.
rules: Respect Xcode, Swift and asset catalog evidence.
Do not invent provisioning, bundle IDs or deployment targets.
Treat Info.plist and entitlements as high-risk.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Summarize
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Summarize selected project tree, code or docs without pretending missing context was inspected.
rules: Summaries must be scope-limited.
Separate observed facts from assumptions.
Do not paste full source dumps.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Search and Fix
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Search selected scope, identify likely cause and prefer the smallest safe fix.
rules: Search selected PROJECT_SCOPE before editing.
Prefer minimal reversible patches over rewrites.
Report validation honestly.

boilerplate_profiles.label: Custom Prompt
boilerplate_profiles.purpose: Wrap user-provided task text with active schema weights, references, roles and project-tree scope.
rules: Do not mutate the user's prompt intent.
Use the wrapper to add boundaries, not a premature solution.
Carry PROJECT_SCOPE, weights and references into the next prompt.
